## Design

| Doc | What it's for | Review |
|---|---|---|
| [Linking Screening Indicators to Constructs](construct_screening_link_design.md) | Proposal: screening steps point at a dish's transgene constructs instead of free text, the catalog records how each fluorescent readout relates to its transgene, and the API and Citrus snapshot serve the result. | checked at `64f4a6c` |
| [Cross Parent Strain and Background Design](cross_parent_background_design.md) | Per-parent strain and background model for PyRAT crosses (cross_parents, background parser). | checked at `384a366` |
| [Derived Dish Numbering](derived_dish_numbering_design.md) | Dishes and well plates made from another dish take the cross's next dish number (19445_7) instead of a suffix like _pos1 or _plate1; the container, parent dish and result are fields on the dish and are shown in the dish list. | checked at `53e6bbc` |
| [Dish Photo Capture and Label Reading](dish_capture_design.md) | A Raspberry Pi in the aquatics room photographs dishes and sends them over an SSH tunnel to a capture inbox in MetaZebrobot; label text is read (local OCR or Claude Haiku) into suggestions a person confirms before the photo is attached to a dish. Larva counting comes later, trained on these photos. | checked at `25ad83c` |
| [Dish Lineage Graph](dish_lineage_graph.md) | Dish lineage as a directed graph built from transfer and screening records. | checked at `384a366` |
| [Crossing Tank Group on Dishes](dish_source_group_design.md) | Enter the crossing tank group written on the aquatics sticker when creating a dish, so screening results can later be read per parent group; the value is as-labelled, not verified. | checked at `81de027` |
| [Fish Deaths and Endings](fish_deaths_design.md) | Proposal: record when and how an individually tracked fish's life in MetaZebrobot ends (found dead, euthanized, propagated), from a fish action or from its dish's termination, keeping dish counts right. | checked at `ddc44df` |
| [Fish Origin and Location](fish_origin_and_location_design.md) | Proposal: give each tracked fish a fixed origin (the dish it came from, whose screening results it inherits) and a changing location (container and well), so mixed plates and post-session isolation keep provenance. | checked at `62b2b9b` |
| [Fish Timeline and Experiment Usage](fish_timeline_design.md) | Proposal: one inspectable timeline per fish, assembled from the records each system owns; MetaZebrobot stores only a link per recording a fish was used in. | checked at `c6a88c1` |
| [Hand-Entered Cross Parents](manual_cross_parents_design.md) | Record a cross parent PyRAT doesn't list (e.g. an IVF sperm donor named only in the crossing description) as a labelled, hand-entered parent, so the cross's dishes get its constructs; PyRAT refreshes keep it. | checked at `139f76b` |
| [Propagation Events and Reference Galleries](propagation_events_design.md) | Proposal: record each propagation (fish handed to aquatics to raise a line) as an event with its dish, screen, count and chosen reference images, so a line's propagations can be compared over time and references picked from one gallery. | checked at `6577bdb` |
| [Screening Images on Dishes and Fish](screening_images_design.md) | Link screening and propagation OME-TIFFs on lab storage to dishes and individual fish by reference, with cached previews in the web app; no image data in SQLite. | checked at `52ebae1` |
| [Tank Heritage and Background Design](tank_heritage_design.md) | Record-derived tank heritage: producing crosses, splits, backgrounds, strain ancestry and renames, plus the heritage view. | checked at `384a366` |
| [User-Scoped Crosses, Dishes, and Fish](user_scoped_workflow_design.md) | Proposal to let each lab member find their own PyRAT crosses live and see their own dishes and fish by default, keeping the cross cache for heritage. | checked at `fcdba01` |
